name: faltwerk-viewer
description: Faltwerk Viewer: WebGPU decoder/player for Faltwerk-format sections (.falt, legacy .csgs)

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/worker.ts src/compare.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist && node -e "for (const f of ['index.html', 'compare.html']) require('fs').copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f)"
